title: Mapping the Ethics of Generative AI: A Comprehensive Scoping Review

bias_targets.methodology: Systematic scoping review and inductive coding (via NVivo) of academic literature to measure the prevalence of ethical concerns regarding racism and stereotyping in generative AI outputs.
Systematic scoping review and inductive coding of academic literature to evaluate the frequency of concerns related to sexism and gender representation in generative AI.
Systematic scoping review and inductive coding to identify and aggregate literature discussions regarding ideological leanings and political biases propagated by foundational models.
Systematic scoping review mapping academic discourse on the imposition of embedded values from AI developers onto distinct global cultures and marginalized minorities.

Systematic scoping review and content analysis to track concerns over unequal access to generative AI for financially constrained groups, developing countries, and the exacerbation of socioeconomic inequalities.
